name: Fifth Metatarsal Fracture
definition: Fracture of the fifth metatarsal ranging from tuberosity avulsion to metaphyseal-diaphyseal Jones fracture and stress fracture, with differing healing risk.

investigations.MRI: MRI/CT may help stress fracture/nonunion assessment.

green: Immobilization and weight-bearing plan based on zone
amber: Jones and high-risk stress fractures may need prolonged protection or fixation in selected patients.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the fifth metatarsal ranging from tuberosity avulsion to metaphyseal-diaphyseal Jones fracture and stress fracture, with differing healing risk.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
